rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying something frankly and without guile.

example.english: To speak ingenuously, I really didn't know things would turn out this way.
example.traditional: 老實咁講，我真係唔知件事會搞成咁。
example.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gam3 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 gin6 si6 wui5 gaau2 sing4 gam3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on speaking plainly or straightforwardly rather than tactfully.

example.english: To put it ingenuously, this plan simply won't work.
example.traditional: 直接咁講，呢個計劃根本行唔通。
example.jyutping: zik6 zip3 gam3 gong2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gan1 bun2 haang4 m4 tung1
